source.author: verg
source.text: Stetimus tela aspera contra contulimusque manus: experto credite, quantus in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam.
source.text_original: Stetimus tela aspera contra / contulimusque manus: experto credite, quantus / in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam.
source.text_english: We stood our ground against the rough weapons and matched our hands with them: believe one who has tried it, how mighty a man rises against a shield, with what whirlwind he hurls his spear.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ego eum bene noui experto credite, quantus in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam : fortis est et in disputando.
reuse.text_original: ego eum bene noui — experto credite, quantus in clipeum assurgat, quo turbine torqueat hastam —: fortis est et in disputando.
reuse.text_english: I know him well; believe one who has experience, how greatly he rises with the shield, with what whirlwind he hurls the spear: he is strong also in argument.
